\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{دربست} (darbast)}{دربست (darbast)}]{\fa{دربست} (darbast) — a private hire (a taxi taken for yourself alone)}

\label{lesson:FA-C435-darbast}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to get a seat, then the Persian for to miss.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{دربست}}
\textbf{\fa{دربست}} (\emph{darbast}) — \textquotedblleft{}a private hire (a taxi taken for yourself alone)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{تا} \fa{فرودگاه} \fa{دربست} \fa{گرفتیم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Tâ forudgâh darbast gereftim.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We took a private taxi to the airport.
\end{quote}

A shared taxi picks up several people on a fixed route; \emph{darbast} means you hire the whole car.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{darbast} is usually analysed as a native compound of \emph{dar} 'in' and \emph{bast} 'closed', the past stem of \emph{bastan} 'to tie, to close', which EtymDB traces to the PIE root \emph{b\textsuperscript{h}end\textsuperscript{h}-}: the whole car, closed to others.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{darbast}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{darbast}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{darbast}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for to get a seat, then the Persian for to miss, then say \emph{darbast} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{دربست} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A private hire (a taxi taken for yourself alone)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{آژانس} (âzhâns)}{آژانس (âzhâns)}]{\fa{آژانس} (âzhâns) — a car service, a minicab office; an agency}

\label{lesson:FA-C435-azhans}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to miss, then the Persian for a private hire.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{آژانس}}
\textbf{\fa{آژانس}} (\emph{âzhâns}) — \textquotedblleft{}a car service, a minicab office; an agency\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{شب} \fa{دیر} \fa{بود} \fa{و} \fa{آژانس} \fa{گرفتیم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Shab dir bud va âzhâns gereftim.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
It was late at night and we called a car service.
\end{quote}

\emph{Âzhâns-e mosâferati} — a travel agency.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{âzhâns} was borrowed from French \emph{agence} 'agency' (EtymDB).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{مسافربری} (mosâferbari)}{مسافربری (mosâferbari)}]{\fa{مسافربری} (mosâferbari) — a coach company; passenger transport}

\label{lesson:FA-C435-mosaferbari}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a private hire, then the Persian for a car service.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{مسافربری}}
\textbf{\fa{مسافربری}} (\emph{mosâferbari}) — \textquotedblleft{}a coach company; passenger transport\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{بلیت} \fa{اتوبوس} \fa{را} \fa{از} \fa{مسافربری} \fa{خریدیم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Bilit-e otobus râ az mosâferbari kharidim.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We bought the bus ticket from the coach company.
\end{quote}

\emph{mosâfer} 'passenger' + \emph{bar} 'carrying' + \emph{-i}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{mosâferbari} is built from \emph{mosâfer} 'traveller', borrowed from Arabic \emph{musāfir}, and native \emph{bar}, the present stem of \emph{bordan} 'to carry', with the ending \emph{-i}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{باربر} (bârbar)}{باربر (bârbar)}]{\fa{باربر} (bârbar) — a porter}

\label{lesson:FA-C435-barbar}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a car service, then the Persian for a coach company.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{باربر}}
\textbf{\fa{باربر}} (\emph{bârbar}) — \textquotedblleft{}a porter\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{باربر} \fa{چمدانهای} \fa{ما} \fa{را} \fa{تا} \fa{تاکسی} \fa{برد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Bârbar chamedân-hâ-ye mâ râ tâ tâksi bord.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The porter took our suitcases to the taxi.
\end{quote}

\emph{bâr} 'load' + \emph{bar} 'carrier'.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{bârbar} is a native compound of \emph{bâr} 'load', which EtymDB lists, and \emph{bar}, the present stem of \emph{bordan} 'to carry': a load-carrier.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{رساندن} (resândan)}{رساندن (resândan)}]{\fa{رساندن} (resândan) — to give someone a lift, to drop off; to deliver}

\label{lesson:FA-C435-resandan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a coach company, then the Persian for a porter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{رساندن}}
\textbf{\fa{رساندن}} (\emph{resândan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to give someone a lift, to drop off; to deliver\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{همکارم} \fa{مرا} \fa{با} \fa{ماشینش} \fa{تا} \fa{خانه} \fa{رساند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Hamkâram marâ bâ mâshinash tâ khâne resând.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My colleague gave me a lift home in his car.
\end{quote}

The causative of \emph{residan} 'to arrive': to make someone arrive. Present stem \emph{resân-}: \emph{miresânam}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\emph{resândan} is built on \emph{residan} 'to arrive', usually traced to Middle Persian \emph{rasīdan}, with the causative ending \emph{-ândan}: to make arrive.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{resândan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{resândan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a coach company, then the Persian for a porter, then say \emph{resândan} again
